basis: Inherited platelet deficiency and dysfunction cause bleeding; bruising and epistaxis do not establish separate skin or airway damage.
Cerebellar hypoplasia and ataxia occur in all assessed patients; weakness and hypotonia do not establish primary muscle disease.
Oocyte maturation arrest causes reproductive infertility without evidence of endocrine dysfunction or another covered organ disorder.
Primary skeletal dysplasia with characteristic humeral, femoral, vertebral and digital abnormalities; facial appearance does not establish additional organ damage.
Keratinizing desquamative squamous epithelial disease is located in the urinary tract.
Congenital anemia is a red blood cell disorder; additional organ damage is not shared across this heterogeneous umbrella.
Digital fusion and carpal abnormalities define skeletal involvement; microdontia and dental pulp calcification define dental involvement. Nail abnormality frequency is unspecified.
Inherited renal tubular magnesium transport disorder produces hypomagnesemia with hypocalciuria.
Glycosylation disorder with seizures, developmental disability and scoliosis; renal dysfunction/proteinuria in ~50%. VSD (2/3), GI malformations (2/4) and strabismus (2/4) omitted at cap.
Skeletal dysplasia; supplied definition also specifies marrow failure, although neutropenia is occasional. Intellectual disability occurs in 12/20 (~60%); airway and ocular defects are occasional.
B-cell hematologic malignancy originating in the lung; lymphoma also requires the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Neurodevelopmental motor and vocal tic disorder; tics do not establish muscle or airway damage.
Tumor originates in the ovary as a reproductive organ; this umbrella does not establish hormone dysfunction.
DNASE1L3-related systemic autoimmunity; direct renal inflammation manifests as lupus nephritis in 11/17 (~65%). Other organ frequencies are not established for this subtype.
Contractures, infiltrative skin disease and immunodeficiency (80–99%) are prominent. GI infiltration causes malabsorption/diarrhea in 80–99%; adrenal abnormalities omitted at cap.
Testicular transitional-cell neoplasm involves a reproductive organ; no endocrine dysfunction is established.
Benign neoplasm of blood vessels; the umbrella includes multiple anatomical sites without establishing additional organ damage across the group.
Chronic nonsuppurative middle-ear disease; effusion alone does not establish active infection or an immune-mediated mechanism.
Synonyms establish mesomelic skeletal dysplasia with radial/thumb abnormalities; the parent and synonyms establish ectodermal dysplasia. Additional organ involvement is unsupported.
Inherited metabolic disorder with tubular dysfunction and cholestasis; arthrogryposis affects 80–99%. Skin, neurologic and platelet abnormalities (30–79%) omitted at cap.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural deafness with cochlear malformation in 4/4 patients; the gene alone does not support other organs.
Squamous carcinoma originates in the uterine corpus, a reproductive organ outside the available axes.
Defining oral clefts, tongue hamartomas and limb malformations; conductive hearing impairment is frequent (30–79%). CNS malformations are occasional.
Bacterial infection directly involves the endocardium; embolic and other distant organ complications do not qualify routinely.
Bile-duct dilatation with congenital hepatic fibrosis defines the syndrome. Renal abnormalities are frequent but associated ARPKD is a separate disease; portal hypertension is occasional.
